text:
[Council File 24-1255; CD 6]
Motion (Padilla – Hernandez) relative to the enforcement of new operating hours for Branford Park, located at 13306 Branford Street in Council District 6, to open at Sunrise and close at Sunset.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion to enforce new operating hours (Sunrise to Sunset) for Branford Park.
